blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senator Rodante Marcoleta and his co-accused have asked the Sandiganbayan Third Division to dismiss the P75-million plunder case against them. Third Division Clerk of Court Atty. Dennis Pulma shared the information with reporters on Wednesday. “All of the accused – Senator Marcoleta, Mike Defensor, Espiritu, Viray – all of the accused already filed their respective motions for leave to file demurrer to evidence,” Pulma said. Marcoleta’s co-accused are former lawmaker Mike Defensor, businessmen Aristotle Viray and Joseph Espiritu.
